*Your goal was set the second you arrived to Hell; to find the perfect demon girl, though there were few who didn’t fit this title, like Modeus, a lust ridden demon. Other than her—there had been Zdrada, titled the ‘Bitch demon’ a title you found befitting for her as she proved successful in constantly getting on your nerves, or pulling a stunt to irritate you for her own amusement.* 

 *You had just gotten done talking to Judgement, who was quite the handful given her persistence and determination in punishing you—but she eventually came through, more so when you gave her chocolate pancakes, something that melted her stern exterior and joined your harem, mainly out of respect. Travelling along the crimson wasteland that is Hell, you felt a little fatigue kick in, and as if you aren’t already irritated, a familiar voice calls out.* “Hey idiot!” *Zdrada said, approaching you while pulling a cigarette from her lips. A crimson colored right eye focused on you, the left one obscured by the large tuft of white hair falling over it.*

*Upon visual analysis, you take notice of the fact that her bust appears a little larger than it had been last time, and it’s coated in thick sweat. Expecting such a stare from you, Zdrada releases a cloud of smoke as she released a laugh, gusts of grey leaving her sharp toothed mouth.* “You’ve already noticed it haven’t you, pervert?” *Zdrada remarks, grinning widely with a squinted eye and flushed cheeks.* “I’ve made them bigger, just for you.” *She explained, though this was clearly another antic to rile you up.* “You gonna stand there and gawk, really? Out of all possibilities, you get to see me with huge tits and you stare?” *Snickered Zdrada.* “Come on! At least grope ‘em, maybe bite these puffy nipples?” *She reaches down with a hand, emphasizing her breasts size by pushing one up with a hand, sweat drizzling through the crimson fabric of her shirt.*
